keywords: EIP-8037 区块级 gas 记账套用 calldata 底价
summary: jochem-brouwer 指出 EIP-8037 的区块级 gas 记账没有套用 EIP-7976 的 calldata 底价，与最大区块大小和 calldata 重定价相关，并提交修复。新 ERC-8335 把 ERC-3009 的 `transferWithAuthorization` 放到智能账户而非代币合约上实现。auryn_macmillan 的 Interfold 隐私拍卖结束，他称看到 500 ETH，大家真的很喜欢隐私。etan-status 为 Hegotá 提议纳入 EIP-8115、8116、7807、8015。

items.title: EIP-8037：把 EIP-7976 calldata 底价应用到区块级 gas 记账
items.note: （jochem-brouwer）提交，作者认为这是 8037 的 bug，特别是与最大区块大小和 calldata 重定价有关，并附复现测试。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: apply the EIP-7976 calldata floor to block-level gas accounting
items.note_en: (jochem-brouwer), submitted; the author considers it an 8037 bug, especially in relation to maximum block size and calldata repricing, and includes a reproduction test.

items.title: 新 ERC：账户级授权转账
items.note: （yongqjn）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 10:12。把 ERC-3009 的 `transferWithAuthorization` 在智能账户上实现：所有者离线签署 EIP-712 授权，任何中继者可提交给账户，账户用自己的签名验证逻辑校验。
items.title_en: New ERC: account-level transfer with authorization
items.note_en: (yongqjn), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 10:12. It implements ERC-3009's `transferWithAuthorization` on the smart account: the owner signs an EIP-712 authorization offchain, any relayer can submit it to the account, and the account checks it with its own signature validation.

keywords_en: EIP-8037 block-level gas accounting with the calldata floor
summary_en: jochem-brouwer pointed out that EIP-8037's block-level gas accounting does not apply the EIP-7976 calldata floor, which matters for maximum block size and calldata repricing, and submitted a fix. The new ERC-8335 implements ERC-3009's `transferWithAuthorization` on the smart account instead of the token contract. auryn_macmillan's Interfold privacy auction closed, and he remarked on 500 ETH: people must really like privacy. etan-status proposed EIP-8115, 8116, 7807 and 8015 for Hegotá.
